resources.string: Enter the four-digit PIN and passphrase from your host. The PIN expires after three minutes.
Enter the four-digit PIN from the host.
Enter the passphrase you chose on the host (at least four characters).

1. Start Rubylight on your PC. Connect both devices to the same network.

2. Tap your PC, or tap Add PC to add its IP address.

3. Enter this app’s pairing PIN under Devices in the host’s web console.

Long-press a PC for settings, details or one-time PIN pairing.
